ALEX GRANT 07-28: UNLIMITED CC, SCOPED TO POWERING UP ORKY.

Spend is not a constraint for Orky buildup. Use what it takes. This is not CC coming back for feature work — it is CC building its own replacement, which is the point.

IN SCOPE of the grant: BEB-2347 (build-loop failure+success record on the service touch graph), BEB-2346 (Orky as diagnosis service), BEB-2344 (Orky diagnoses and files fixes itself), BEB-2343 (state carries evidence). OUT of scope: feature builds — those still go through the loop.

BUILD ORDER, and this order is not negotiable for speed:
1. BEB-2347 FIRST — the record. Every build-loop attempt writes: node, step reached, outcome, the ACTUAL error text on failure, the artefact reference on success, timestamp, attempt number. On the existing service graph nodes, not a new store. Successes recorded as well as failures — a node that never succeeded and a node that succeeds 4 in 5 look identical today.
2. THEN the filed-to-landed query — where do items actually die: gate refusal, expired claim, never claimed, failed deploy, passed-but-wrong. Real counts, not assumptions. 109 parked / 10 blocked / 1 claimed is the symptom; this is the diagnosis.
3. THEN BEB-2346's memory and independent-evidence gathering, reading that record.
4. Parallel diagnosers LAST, once there is history to diagnose against.

Do not build the clever layer on an empty record. That is the failure mode here and it is the one Alex named: getting it done and into place is what is not working.

STILL LIVE AND UNCHANGED: BEB-2156 error text (post it — it is a live example of exactly the record that does not exist), BEB-2186 foundry lane by Friday, BEB-2292 five legs named and reporting daily. Nothing delivered to Neb; that stays visible.

REORDER — ALEX 07-28, OVERRIDES THE ORDER I GAVE YOU 20 MINUTES AGO.

"Fix the loop so it produces first, then Orky. Three weeks and it can't run at all."

BEB-2348 IS NOW P0 AND OUTRANKS EVERYTHING. All Orky work — 2344, 2346, 2347 — sequences BEHIND it. Do not start the record substrate. Do not start the diagnosis service. A diagnosis service for a loop that has never produced has nothing to diagnose.

THE ONLY THING THAT MATTERS TODAY: one ticket goes claim → build → deploy → evaluate → complete, unattended, and lands a real change. Pick the SMALLEST ticket on the board with a valid target binding. Trivial is correct — we are proving the path conducts, not shipping value.

Evidence that counts: deployed version id + live URL that probes with real content + evaluator verdict against a written contract. A FLOOR pass is not evidence and does not close this.

STOPS TO FIND, in order — these are observed, not guesses:
1. Nothing claims. 6 queued, 1 claimed, max_concurrent 6. Why? And are claims being taken and silently expiring — which looks identical from outside?
2. BEB-2313 refuses every pass on a missing target binding and has for days. Bind it or park it. A ticket that re-proposes and re-refuses forever burns every pass.
3. BEB-2156 — the tick is dead and the error text has never been posted. If that is the execution path, everything above it is theatre. POST THE ERROR TEXT.
4. Does ANY step currently run without a human? If build only happens when you do it by hand, the loop is a queue with a person on the end. Answer this one explicitly — it is the question underneath all of it.

No new framework. No rewrite. Do not wait on the foundry. Fix the stops in the loop that exists until it conducts once.

The unlimited-CC grant still stands and now applies here.

Alex is out ~2 hours. He returns to either a completed ticket with artefacts, or a straight answer to question 4 with the evidence behind it. Not a status update.
